item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-b631d00457fb855a","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 4 October 2023, Sheikh Hasina stated that Bangladesh was pursuing nuclear power to meet electricity demand and reduce fossil-fuel dependence; she said Rooppur would supply 2,400 MW, that advanced safety measures were being used with Russia, and that IAEA guidelines had been followed for nuclear safety.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.4","1B.7","1B.10","5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; primarily a government statement of intended safeguards and benefits, not independent verification.","ruler_attribution":"Sheikh Hasina made the commitments and attributed implementation to her government.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify compliance with IAEA guidance, safety performance, staffing, funding, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4d6c31b86a91065","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Bangladesh received its first Russian uranium shipment for Rooppur in October 2023. The project was 90% financed by a Russian loan repayable over 28 years with a 10-year grace period; construction had been delayed by COVID-19 restrictions and sanctions, and commissioning faced further loan-repayment setbacks amid a severe electricity crisis and foreign-exchange pressures.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.4","1B.10","5B.3","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The project was undertaken by Hasina’s government; the source reports project and financing conditions rather than personal decisions beyond the government’s role.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether Hasina personally controlled financing, safety, or commissioning decisions.","No independent assessment of nuclear safeguards or economic value is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11303de8850a84e9","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In August 2023, Hasina presented a government energy program involving rational gas use, discovery of six gas fields, new exploration terms, gas-network pipelines, prepaid meters, increased fuel storage, oil-handling infrastructure, refinery expansion, and 624 km of fuel pipelines; she also endorsed alternative and environment-friendly energy and reduced energy waste.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; several projects were ongoing rather than completed.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina announced and attributed the program and project progress to her government.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify expenditures, implementation quality, distributional effects, environmental impacts, or completed outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0b03d0de8fc5741d","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 4 October 2023, Hasina described Rooppur as entering its final phase after fuel delivery, expected to provide 2,400 MW, reduce fossil-fuel dependence and carbon emissions, and support economic development; she stated that the project used advanced security in cooperation with Russia and followed IAEA nuclear-safety guidelines.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.4","1B.7","1B.10","5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; duplicates the substantive claims in SRC-b631d00457fb855a but independently records the same public position.","ruler_attribution":"Sheikh Hasina made the statements and attributed project execution to her government.","limitations":["The source is a government-linked news report and does not independently verify safety, compliance, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fa422c028d100d74","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, the first Rooppur uranium shipment arrived under special security arrangements; the project director withheld shipment details on security grounds, and army and law-enforcement personnel were assigned to transport the fuel. The first unit was expected to be commissioned in September 2024 and the second in mid-2025.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023, with commissioning dates projected beyond the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The security and commissioning arrangements were government project actions; the source attributes operational details to project officials.","limitations":["The source does not verify the adequacy of custody, inspection, command-and-control, or emergency safeguards.","Projected commissioning dates are not outcomes achieved during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dd8007018529d0e2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In June 2023, Hasina defended the approximately Tk 7.62 trillion proposed 2023–24 budget and pledged transformation into a developed, prosperous, smart Bangladesh by 2041. She cited fuel agreements with Qatar and Oman and additional negotiations to address load shedding, while attributing the electricity and inflation crisis to global conditions including COVID-19, the Russia–Ukraine war, and sanctions.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; concerns a proposed fiscal-year budget and policy pledges rather than fully observed execution.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina publicly defended the budget, stated the development goals, and described the fuel-supply response.","limitations":["The source does not independently assess budget execution, fiscal sustainability, targeting, or whether the measures relieved hardship.","Her attribution of difficulties to external shocks is a political explanation, not an independently tested causal finding."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1ea0009c118dc4b8","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In April 2023, Hasina urged Islamic scholars to use mosque sermons to oppose militancy, narcotics, corruption, violence against women, rumors, and inhumane treatment of domestic workers and subordinates; she inaugurated 50 additional model mosques and Islamic cultural centres.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","5B.6","6B.1","6B.3","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina issued the appeal and inaugurated the facilities.","limitations":["The source does not show whether sermons changed conduct, whether the facilities improved welfare, or whether enforcement and funding were effective."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-62e4d23af18c7b5c","SRC-a536b46cc44cb7f0","SRC-225a293854c7c875","SRC-881d90dd3da413f0","SRC-c31b0adc3c76eff1"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern periods before 2023 or provide only page metadata; they were not treated as direct evidence for the 2023–2023 ruler-period.","The supplied material is concentrated on energy, nuclear power, and public pledges, with little evidence on courts, elections, media freedom, corruption investigations, social-service delivery, or verified outcomes."]}
